description: This file defines the KpiService class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It manages KPI entities, including fetching a DAO instance and saving KPI objects with validation and transaction management.

classes.name: KpiService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing KPIs, handling data persistence, validation, and transaction control.

methods.name: getKpiDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the KpiDao instance used for data access operations.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Validates and saves a Kpi object, handling default KPI status and transaction boundaries.
